title: A face with eyes
goals: Eyes: lids cut along their edges, a globe with iris and cornea, lashes, brows
The head laid out anew from measures: a forehead, a nose, two lips, a chin, a jaw
A warm base face: a whole smile over good teeth, blue eyes with a spark in each, a narrower, shorter chin
Ears of their own: a rim, a bowl, a lobe, standing off the head
The tool draws the face and prints its measures; the body as it was
Seen in the library on a real GPU, and timed
The gate, a photograph of a real smiling face: skin, light, a smile of the whole face
Photoreal: hair, skin that differs from place to place, a face that moves

clips.name: The meadow, one tent
clips.why: the game as it starts: the one tent on the meadow, where whoever lives here will stand and be looked in the face. The Body itself stands in the library, not yet in this world

clips.name: Towards the tent
clips.why: nearer, at a person's eyes: a face is judged from here, an arm's length

clips.name: Back and up
clips.why: back from the tent and up: what is a face now and what is not yet, said plainly over the whole of it

captions.text: Ok eyes and face is the worst at the moment
Its eyes were two balls looking out of holes.
Now a lid's edge is cut pixel by pixel, over a globe with an iris.
With eyes in it the head was still a mask. So I laid it out anew.
The base view should be a smile and sparkle in the eyes.
Friendly heartwarming gaze, a human in love and full of inspiration.
And the ears need to be more realistic
It cannot move yet. So its rest is a whole smile, over good teeth.
Its lids smile too, and each eye holds a spark.
Ears with a rim, a bowl and a lobe, 19 mm off the head.
Warm, yes. A photograph, no: no hair, no blink.
Seen on a software GPU only. Not yet in the library.
